review_type: single-reviewer comprehensive scoping and critical narrative review
limits: No complete bibliographic-database exports or reproducible ranked-search result denominator; no PRISMA counts claimed
Single-reviewer eligibility and appraisal; no independent duplicate screening
Selected full-text assessment is not a claim that 60 papers were read in full
Metadata verification does not establish claim support; use access depth and evidence notes
No quantitative meta-analysis: tasks, datasets, metrics, priors, instruments and reference standards differ
Publisher/arXiv correction flags checked opportunistically; no comprehensive retraction-status database audit
General methods, reviews and software are explicitly distinguished from direct empirical inference evidence
No experiments rerun; current-project numerical results attributed to local manuscript/report
